title: Results in input order
hints: Results arrive on the channel in the order the goroutines finish, not the order they started. A slow first fetch arrives last.
Send the index along with the value, for example a struct{ i int; body string }, then store each result at results[r.i].
type result struct { i int; body string }; ch := make(chan result); go func() { ch <- result{i, fetch(u)} }(); … for range urls { r := <-ch; results[r.i] = r.body }
